Residential

Re-Inspection

Verify the developer actually fixed what they promised.

Owners after developer repairsDLP claimants
Residential

Developers often mark defects as 'rectified' when the work is incomplete or cosmetic. We re-visit with your original defect list, verify each item one by one, and record the closure status with before-and-after photos.

What's included

  • Item-by-item verification against the original list
  • Before & after photo comparison
  • Workmanship quality check on repairs
  • New defects arising from repair work flagged
  • Outstanding items listed for follow-up

Instruments we use

SIRIM Calibrated
Thermal CameraMoisture Meter

What you receive

  • Closure status report per defect
  • Before/after photo evidence
  • Outstanding defect list

Status Classification

Every Defect Verified & Classified

We don't just take the developer's word — every item is re-checked and given an honest status

Complete

Rectification done properly and verified by our surveyor

Tolerance

Minor variation within acceptable standard — no rectification required

Not Fully Complete

Repaired, but not fully or not to acceptable standard

Not Complete

Not rectified at all since the first inspection

New Defect

New defect discovered during the re-inspection

New Defect from Rectification Work

Damage caused by the rectification work itself
